# openinfra_application (Resource)

A `kind: Application` — a container workload compiled into a Deployment, Service, Ingress and HPA. Use `openinfra_database` for a data-only application.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Container image to run.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `expose` (Boolean) Publish the app through an Ingress.
- `host` (String) Ingress hostname when `expose` is set.
- `namespace` (String)
- `port` (Number) Container port the app listens on.
- `replicas` (Number) Desired replica count (minimum, when autoscaling is enabled).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application reports Ready.
